signals.title: Holders ~32% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.68: price is 32% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.539). Yet 61% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has risen 0.54→0.68 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

signals.title: -80% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

signals.title: Up +23% in 30d, but Fear & Greed is still 22
signals.detail: Price has recovered +23% over the month while sentiment sits at 22 (fear). The move isn't being believed yet.
signals.framing: Recovery running ahead of sentiment — the crowd hasn't caught up.
signals.note: Not a prediction; just the sentiment-vs-price gap.
